rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling sad or generally unhappy.

example.english: I've been unhappy a lot lately.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when someone is dissatisfied with a product, service, result, or situation.

example.english: I'm very unhappy with this service.
example.traditional: 我對呢個服務好唔滿意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 fuk6 mou6 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3
